buildCommand: npx convex deploy --cmd-url-env-var-name VITE_CONVEX_URL --cmd 'npm run build'

git._comment: NEO-143: main is released by .github/workflows/release.yml, NOT by the Vercel git integration. The integration deployed on merge in parallel with the Cloud Run lanes, so a build whose Convex code needed the new browser service could go live minutes before it — that is what broke production on the NEO-141 merge. release.yml promotes the services first, then runs vercel pull/build/deploy --skip-domain, smokes the staged build, and only then promotes. Re-enabling this races that pipeline. PR previews are unaffected: they build from PR branches, not main.
